roadmap_item: R5 (R5a spatial neutrals + R5b metastables / stepwise ionisation) of modern/docs/pic2d-physics-completeness-audit.md section 5; gaps (f) and (e2) of sections 4.f / 4.e
status: code-and-tests-complete; shakedown-only; no preregistered run; physics not validated
supersedes: adds ONE selectable neutral model (neutrals_spatial_v1, with the optional metastables_v1 block) beside the v1.3 / v1.4 / v2.3.0 0-D inventory, which stays as neutrals.model = inventory-0d with every recorded identity and replay unchanged; v2.4 is reserved for the Coulomb stream (R4); every v2.0.x / v2.1 / v2.2 / v2.3 contract (gates, ledgers, checkpoints, collision set, SEE) is kept
unchanged_from_v2_3: domain, field, time step, Boris push, ion subcycling, fixed-point deposition, bilinear gather, dielectric surface-charge closure, cathode models, gates, energy ledger W convention, momentum ledger keys, Poisson solvers, frame recorder, checkpoint binding for every configuration without the neutrals_spatial block; the 0-D inventory (feed, artificial relaxation, wall recycling, fast-neutral sink) byte for byte
what_changed: Neutral model choice (PIC2DConfig.neutrals_spatial: SpatialNeutralConfig | None; mutually exclusive with neutral_inventory): test-particle neutrals in free-molecular flight on the (r, z) grid replace the single scalar n_g(t). The 0-D inventory is neutrals.model = inventory-0d and reproduces origin head 8e02db57 bitwise on cpu and warp-cpu (pinned state hashes in test_pic2d_v25_neutrals_spatial.py; the same 150-step discharge, legacy set and xe_collision_set_v2).

Density read by the MCCs: the electron MCC and the Xe+ - Xe ion MCC read the PUBLISHED per-cell ground density (absolute, clamped at the null-collision ceiling n_g0 = mcc.neutral_density_per_m3) from a device-resident cell array rewritten at every neutral sub-step - never a kernel scalar (the 2026-09-04 CUDA-graph lesson) - instead of n_g0 x scale x two-zone shape; the ion MCC samples its target atom from the cell's deposited drift + thermal speed; the born ion takes the local gas velocity.

Weight-consistent depletion: every ionisation (W atoms), CEX event (W: the atom that became the slow ion), stepwise ionisation / superelastic event (W metastable atoms) and excitation into the pool (b_k W) is booked as a per-cell INTEGER sink (units W / 2**20) by the MCC kernels; at the next sub-step the cell's weights are scaled so exactly the demanded atoms leave; what an empty cell cannot deliver is carried as a per-cell DEBT and removed when atoms arrive. The demanded ionisation atoms equal F x W x (ground ionisations) exactly (sink_consistency_atoms = 0 in every record).

Wall-ion recycling at the impact cell: the push books recomb x W atoms into the ion's last plasma cell for dielectric / cone / anode impacts (not the exit / far field / body face); spawned there as thermal atoms at T_w at the macro-weight granularity (per-cell carry).

CEX fast neutrals are particles: the ion MCC hands the ion's pre-event velocity over at the ion position with weight F x W; their exit / wall thermalisation is the transport's (the v2.3.0 straight-line fate march is bypassed; the 0-D path keeps it).

Transport: straight flight in path pieces <= 0.5 min(dr, dz) (the same meridional-frame advance as the charged particles), diffuse (cosine law about the inward face normal at T_w) or specular reflection with the accommodation coefficient at the dielectric walls, cone stairs and anode; exit through the aperture (channel domains) or the far-field boundary (plume domains) with the axial momentum / kinetic energy tallied (cold-gas + fast-neutral thrust, neutral_exit_thrust_n).

Time acceleration F (declared, default 1 = physical): the neutrals advance F x further per sub-step with the feed, recycling, hand-off weight and the plasma sinks scaled by F - the spatial generalisation of the v1.3 artificial relaxation tau_g; the atom ledger runs in neutral time and the record divides the plasma-coupled terms by F for the real-time balance V dn/dt = Q + R - S - F_cex - c n.

Metastables (metastables_v1): the Xe(6s) pool is a second state of the neutral arrays with macro weight weight_ratio x W_n, fed by the declared branching b_k of every excitation level, lost by stepwise ionisation (BEB, threshold E_iz - E_m = 3.815 eV) and superelastic de-excitation (Klein-Rosseland detailed balance from the bound level-1 table; the atom returns to the ground pool) as two extra channels of the electron MCC against the LOCAL metastable density, by wall de-excitation (state flip on wall contact) and an optional radiative decay rate; nu_max gains the metastable ceiling term ceiling_fraction x n_g0 x max sigma v.

Ledgers: the energy ledger's inelastic term now carries + n_step (E_iz - E_m) - n_super E_m per macro event (times W); ionizations counts ground + stepwise births (particle-count identity); 23 neutral ledger keys (neutral_* / meta_*, atoms in neutral time) as EXTRA cumulative keys (absent without the block); series neutral record with model, atoms, densities (channel mean, axis anode / exit, max), real-time rates, identities (interval_ledger_residual_atoms, interval_meta_ledger_residual_atoms, sink_consistency_atoms), debts / carries and a metastables sub-record; window maps / frames gain neutral_density_per_m3 and metastable_density_per_m3 (cell-centred) with neutral_samples.

Identity: SpatialNeutralConfig.to_dict (model name, feed, macro weight, substep_steps, time_acceleration, wall temperature, accommodation, recycling, recombination, initial profile / density, max_ceiling_violation_fraction, the metastables block) enters PIC2DConfig.to_dict and therefore config_sha256 only when declared; checkpoints carry the neutral particles + per-cell carries / debts / published fields (neutrals_* arrays) and resume bitwise.

Warp backend: a sixth seed column (stream id 6) for the neutral sub-step appended without changing columns 0-4; the sub-step is its own CUDA-graph variant (cell sums -> depletion factors / carries / spawn counts -> spawn (scan) -> free flight -> deposit / publish); all cell sums and sinks are int64 fixed point so graph and direct launches replay bitwise; STATS_STEPWISE / STATS_SUPERELASTIC slots appended; fast-neutral hand-off after every ion MCC launch (per-ion-slot flag + inclusive scan).

Runner: operating_point.neutrals = {model: neutrals_spatial_v1, ...fields, metastables: {...} | null} replaces operating_point.neutral_inventory (either, not both); records_to_arrays / status / summary carry the new scalars (neutral_*, metastable_*) and the spatial summary (ledger closure in neutral time, real-time plasma terms, trailing profile readings).

model_choice.chosen: (A) DSMC-lite / test-particle neutrals (collisionless free-molecular flight with diffuse wall reflection, ionisation / excitation / CEX depletion, wall recycling, real CEX fast neutrals, cell-deposited density read by both MCCs) - the route of Brandt et al. 2016's static DSMC field, made dynamic and slowly varying
model_choice.cost_argument: free-molecular regime: at n_g 1e19-1e20 the atom-atom mean free path (sigma_nn ~ 3e-19 m2) is 3-30 cm against a 4 mm bore, Kn ~ 10-100, so atom-atom collisions are dropped (declared) and the transport is straight lines + wall reflections. Population: N_atoms ~ 8.7e13 in the 24 mm channel at the ss-v4 feed (Knudsen profile 5.5e20 -> 5.5e19); at W_n 2.2e7 that is ~4 M macro-neutrals (~60 per cell on 90 x 720, 14 % shot noise per cell in the published density, averaged by the electrons over their paths). Sub-cycled every substep_steps = 200 PIC steps (0.28 ns of plasma time; thermal atoms move 60 nm, F = 100 -> 6 um = 0.2 cell): ~9 kernels over ~4 M threads ~ 1.5-2 ms per sub-step on an H100 = 8-10 us per PIC step, 0.3-0.4 % of a 2.5 ms step; memory 4 M x 8 arrays x 8 B x 2 (compaction scratch) ~ 0.5 GB. The view-factor / fluid alternative (B) would cost nothing per step but cannot carry the fast CEX neutrals, the wall-temperature mixture or the recycling at the impact point, and needs a Picard iteration of its own between windows; (A) was implemented.
model_choice.what_the_model_is_not: no atom-atom collisions (Kn >> 1 declared); no plume neutraliser gas (gap g); wall reflection is instantaneous (no adsorption); the anode face is a diffuse wall at T_w and the feed enters through it with a cosine-law flux Maxwellian at T_g (no injector geometry); the density is a nearest-cell deposit (the cell the two-zone shape used), not a bilinear node field

quasi_steady_state_and_time_acceleration.physical_time_scales: tube residence V / c ~ 0.2 ms; Knudsen diffusion time L^2 / D_K ~ 2 ms; local depletion time in the ionisation flames ~ 10-20 us; a 3-transit run is ~7 us -> the physical neutral field over a run is the initial profile minus local depletion (smoothed by transport over ~1 mm) plus recycling; it does NOT reach the profile self-consistent with the plasma
quasi_steady_state_and_time_acceleration.time_acceleration: F >= 1 (default 1) multiplies the neutral sub-step time; feed, recycling, hand-off weight and every plasma sink scale by F, so the fixed point of the neutral system is unchanged and reached F x faster (like tau_g in v1.3, only the fixed point is physical; the transient is not). The ledger is kept in neutral time; the record reports real-time rates (ledger / F / interval). A run with F > 1 must say so; F enters config_sha256.
quasi_steady_state_and_time_acceleration.initial_profile: knudsen (default): the closed-end Knudsen-diffusion profile dn/dz = -3 Q / (2 pi a(z)^3 v_bar) integrated from the exit density 4 Q / (v_bar A_exit) (the 0-D zero-ionisation value; initial_density_per_m3 overrides it) with isotropic Maxwellian velocities at T_g; uniform; empty (tests). For the ss-v4 feed the Knudsen anode density is 5.5e20 = 10 x the exit value (bore 2 mm, L 24 mm, exit radius 3 mm): the MCC ceiling must exceed it (raise mcc.neutral_density_per_m3; the initial state fails closed otherwise). Consequence stated up front: the channel-averaged density at a given feed is ~4-5 x the 0-D fixed point's - the 0-D closure equated the whole channel to the exit density.

transport.advance: per sub-step: pieces of duration min(remaining, 0.5 min(dr, dz) / |v|) with the meridional-frame rotation (kernels.advance_positions); a piece that would land outside the plasma cells reflects at the pre-move position; the exit plane inside the aperture (channel) or the far-field boundary (plume) removes the atom (effused; pz / ke tallied); the anode plane reflects like a wall
transport.wall_reflection: with probability accommodation_coefficient: diffuse - normal component v_th,w sqrt(-2 ln u) (cosine-law flux Maxwellian), tangential components Gaussian at T_w, about the inward normal of the crossed face (radial face, axial stair face or the anode; corner -> radial); otherwise specular (normal component flipped). Metastables de-excite on wall contact with wall_deexcitation_probability. Accommodation / T_w for BN and Al2O3 are unmeasured (audit B section 3(e)); alpha = 1, T_w = 500 K are the declared defaults of the shakedown
transport.rng: CPU: numpy default_rng([seed, step, 6]) per sub-step; Warp: seed-table column 5 (stream id 6), rand_init(seed, cell) for spawns and rand_init(seed, slot + n_cells) for the flight
transport.verification: Clausing transmission of a diffuse tube L/D = 2 closed by the fed anode: K = Q / (Q + anode re-emission) = 0.3548 measured vs 0.3564 tabulated (Clausing 1932; test tolerance 5 %); Knudsen gradient of a L/D = 4 tube within 25 % (end effects steepen it ~15 %), anode density within 15 % of the Knudsen profile; plume domains effuse through the far field and reflect on the front face

depletion_and_sources.sinks: per-cell int64 counts in units of W / 2**20 booked by mcc_kernel (ground ionisation: 2**20; excitation level k: rint(b_k 2**20); stepwise: 2**20 on the metastable sink; superelastic: 2**20 on the return sink), ion_mcc_kernel (CEX: 2**20), push_kernel (wall / anode ion: rint(recomb 2**20)); the CPU reference books the same quantised fractions (quantised_fraction)
depletion_and_sources.removal: demand = F x sinks + debt; removed = min(demand, cell weight); factor = 1 - removed / weight applied to every ground (metastable) macro-particle of the cell; debt = demand - removed carried; the two metastable demands (stepwise, superelastic) share the removal in proportion and keep separate debts; the superelastic share of the removed metastable atoms returns to the ground carry
depletion_and_sources.spawns: feed Q x F x dt_sub distributed over the anode-face bore cells by area; recycling F x recomb x W per impact at the impact cell (isotropic Maxwellian at T_w inside the cell - the wall re-emits atoms that head into it); superelastic return at T_g; metastables at weight_ratio x W_n with the cell's deposited drift / thermal speed; every source spawned at its macro-weight granularity with a per-cell carry (pending_*); CEX hand-off: one particle per event, weight F x W
depletion_and_sources.identities: true ground atoms = particles + carries - debt; d(true ground) = fed + recycled + fast_in + returned + meta_wall + meta_radiative - ionized - cex_converted - excited_to_pool - effused; d(true meta) = excited_to_pool - meta_ionized - meta_superelastic - meta_wall - meta_radiative - meta_effused; both to round-off in every interval (float atomics on the ledger sums: <= 1e-13 relative on the device); sink_consistency_atoms = neutral_ionized - F W (ionizations - stepwise) = 0 exactly
depletion_and_sources.fail_closed: the published density is clamped at the ceiling and every clamped cell-substep is counted (neutral_ceiling_violations); the record raises when the clamped fraction of the interval's plasma cell-substeps exceeds max_ceiling_violation_fraction (default 1e-3: the ~1/sqrt(N_cell) deposit noise makes rare excursions unavoidable; 0 = any); device array overflow and an unresolved flight (piece cap 64 (nr + nz) + 64) raise at the sync

metastables_v1.pool: Xe 6s[3/2]_2 (1s5) at 8.315 eV; the 6s'[1/2]_0 (1s3, 9.447 eV) metastable is folded into the same pool (its 1.13 eV excess radiated / collisionally relaxed - declared simplification)

branching_defaults.derivation: Biagi-v7.1's 8.315 eV level lumps the 1s5 metastable with the 1s4 resonance level (8.437 eV) and the 9.447 eV level lumps 1s3 with 1s2 (9.570 eV): the metastable shares are the ratio of the level-resolved BSR cross sections (Zatsarinny and Bartschat; Allan et al. 2006 near threshold) - comparable peaks with the optically allowed partner rising above 20 eV -> 0.45 / 0.35; the 9.917 eV level is the 6p manifold, whose radiative cascade lands ~50 % in 1s5 + 1s3 (Aymar and Coulombe 1978 transition probabilities: 2p9 -> 1s5 100 %, 2p8 73 %, 2p6 ~50 %, 2p7 ~35 %, 2p10 ~50 %, 2p5 0 %); the 11.7 eV block cascades through 6p / 5d -> ~0.35. Net pool feed ~0.43 of the excitation events (the audit's 0.3 estimate lies inside the x3 uncertainty). Resonance-level atoms are NOT pooled: at n_g >= 1e19 over 3 mm the 147 nm line is optically thick (k_0 L ~ 30) but the Holstein escape factor still gives an effective lifetime ~0.3 us, shorter than the ~3-10 us electron-collision times, so they radiate before they ionise (audit 4.e's 'whole manifold effectively metastable' is superseded here).
sources: M. Aymar and M. Coulombe, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 21, 537 (1978), doi:10.1016/0092-640X(78)90007-4
M. Allan, O. Zatsarinny, K. Bartschat, Phys. Rev. A 74, 030701 (2006), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.74.030701
K.-P. Nick and V. Helbig, Phys. Scr. 32, 111 (1985), doi:10.1088/0031-8949/32/2/004 (6s-6p' / 6s-7p branching ratios)
branching_defaults.uncertainty: x3 on the pool feed (branching x trapping); MetastableConfig.branching is the sensitivity knob and enters config_sha256

stepwise_ionization.cross_section: Binary-Encounter-Bethe (Y.-K. Kim and M. E. Rudd, Phys. Rev. A 50, 3954 (1994), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.50.3954) with binding B = E_iz - E_m = 3.815 eV, orbital kinetic energy U = B (virial), N = 1: peak 8.4e-20 m2 at 16.6 eV; 2.4e-20 (5 eV), 7.4e-20 (10 eV), 6.0e-20 (50 eV), 3.9e-20 (100 eV)
stepwise_ionization.literature_bracket: D. Ton-That and M. R. Flannery, Phys. Rev. A 15, 517 (1977), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.15.517 (Born / binary encounter, 6-250 eV); H. A. Hyman, Phys. Rev. A 20, 855 (1979), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.20.855 (symmetric binary encounter); H. Deutsch, K. Becker, S. Matt, T. D. Maerk, J. Phys. B 32, 4249 (1999), doi:10.1088/0953-4075/32/17/309 (Deutsch-Maerk): peaks of 1-4e-19 m2 quoted for Xe* - the BEB default sits at the low end of the audit's 1-3e-19 m2 bracket; stepwise_scale (default 1) is the declared sensitivity knob (x3)
stepwise_ionization.rate_coefficients_maxwellian: k_step / k_iz(ground) = 10.0 / 5.7 / 3.6 at T_e 5 / 7 / 10 eV (BEB vs Biagi ionisation); with n_m / n_g ~ 0.02 the stepwise share of the ionisation is ~0.07-0.2, inside the audit's 0.18-0.23 (x3) estimate
stepwise_ionization.kinematics: as ground ionisation with the threshold E_iz - E_m (Vahedi-Surendra secondary; ion born with the local gas velocity); ledger: the electron loses E_iz - E_m, the pool's E_m becomes the ion's potential energy (total E_iz)

metastables_v1.superelastic_deexcitation: e + Xe* -> e + Xe + E_m; Klein-Rosseland detailed balance sigma_super(E') = (g_0 / g_m) (E / E') sigma_exc(E) with E = E' + E_m, g_0 / g_m = 1/5, sigma_exc = the branching share of the bound level-1 table (the lumped level's metastable part); ~8.5e-22 m2 at 1-10 eV; the electron gains E_m (isotropic), the atom returns to the ground pool (ledger neutral_returned); k_super ~ 1.3-1.7e-15 m3/s at 5-10 eV (2 % of k_step)
metastables_v1.other_channels_declared: excitation out of the metastable to 6p (Jung et al. 2005) mostly cascades back into the 6s manifold -> a null process for the pool (not modelled; the electron's ~1.5 eV loss per such event is neglected); metastable-metastable Penning ionisation (~1e2 /s at n_m 5e17) and ground-atom quenching (~30 /s) neglected; radiative decay rate 0 for the true metastables (radiative_decay_rate_per_s is the knob for a resonance-level variant)
metastables_v1.wall: de-excitation on contact with wall_deexcitation_probability (default 1; the atom stays, ground state) - the pool's E_m goes to the wall (not tallied as wall heat: recorded as meta_wall_deexcited atoms)
metastables_v1.verification: MCC channel rates against n_m sigma v dt N on a 20 eV beam within 4 sigma; energy bookkeeping (stepwise threshold removed, E_m gained) exact; BEB shape / bracket; detailed balance value; production / radiative survival / wall de-excitation and both atom identities in the transport; the pool empties onto the walls of a tube in ~300 sub-steps

identity.how: PIC2DConfig.to_dict()['neutrals_spatial'] = SpatialNeutralConfig.to_dict() (model, feed_atoms_per_s, macro_weight, substep_steps, time_acceleration, wall_temperature_k, accommodation_coefficient, wall_recycling, recombination_coefficient, initial_profile, initial_density_per_m3, max_ceiling_violation_fraction, metastables{model, branching, pool_energy_ev, weight_ratio, ceiling_fraction, beb_kinetic_ev, stepwise_scale, superelastic, superelastic_level, superelastic_weight_ratio, wall_deexcitation_probability, radiative_decay_rate_per_s}); present only when declared
identity.inventory_0d_bitwise: 2026-09-05: the inventory-0d discharge (12 x 96 CFT grid, 300 V, injection 50 mA, n_g0 1e21 recycling inventory, ion_subcycle 4, 150 steps) run on origin head 8e02db57 and on this tree gives identical sha256 digests of (electrons, ions, phi, surface charge), identical counts, neutral state and ledgers on cpu (legacy set 4605199d..., xe_collision_set_v2 193888c2...) and warp-cpu (dd68d1f4..., f7aefe74...) with identical config identities (931a6a04..., c269ab72...); the SEE-off v2.0.6 pins and the ss-v4 identity f10772b2 pins of the earlier tests stay green; the CUDA replay is part of the box run
identity.graph_vs_direct: bitwise with the spatial model + metastables on (CUDA test): int64 fixed-point cell sums / sinks make the published density independent of the thread order
identity.checkpoint: neutrals_r_m ... neutrals_state + neutrals_cell_<13 keys> arrays, neutral_particle_count / spatial_neutral_cell_keys / neutral_time_s / neutral_substeps metadata; loads only into a configuration with the block (and a 0-D checkpoint only without it); resume bitwise

predeclared_expectations.reference: ss-v4 33 um channel-only plateau 0d228ad2 (I_d 3.80 mA, S 3.60e16 /s, n_g 3.19e19, peak n_e 1.29e18, T_e,peak 5.58 eV) under the 0-D closure
predeclared_expectations.neutral_field: anode-side density several times the exit density (Knudsen 10 x for this geometry at the ss-v4 feed); the channel-mean density at the same feed 4-5 x the 0-D fixed point -> the plateau under the spatial model is NOT the 0-D plateau at the same feed: S and I_d UP strongly until the feed limits the ionisation (gross utilisation -> 1), then local depletion in the flames
predeclared_expectations.where_ionisation_sits: the cusp-anchored flames weight toward the anode side (density x electron presence), exit-cusp S down; the exit-plane density (plume CEX, cold-gas thrust) below the 0-D value
predeclared_expectations.metastables: n_m / n_g ~ 1-2 % in the channel mean, higher in the flames; stepwise share of the ionisation 0.07-0.2 (x3 uncertain through branching and the BEB bracket); superelastic heating of the cold electron population small (k_super ~ 2 % of k_step)
predeclared_expectations.not_a_result: the 100k-step shakedown (0.14 us) shows the initial Knudsen profile and the seed transient only; the direction statements above are hypotheses for the R5 runs, which need the feed / ceiling re-declared for the spatial model and are not scheduled here

runner_block_example.operating_point.neutral_density_per_m3: 1e21 (the ceiling; >= the Knudsen anode density 5.5e20 with 5.5 sigma headroom for the ~13 % per-cell deposit noise)

neutrals_spatial_v1.shakedown: experiments/pic2d_neutrals_spatial_v1_shakedown/ (the ss-v4 33 um protocol with operating_point.neutrals replacing neutral_inventory, the ceiling raised to 1e21, xe_collision_set_v2 on; 100 000 steps through finalize + assess on the Lambda H100 as an extra MPS client; NOT a result; reports the axis density profile, where the ionisation sits vs the 0-D shakedown, the metastable fraction and the sub-step cost)
neutrals_spatial_v1.tests: tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_v25_neutrals_spatial.py (18): Clausing conductance; Knudsen gradient; inventory-0d bitwise vs origin head (cpu / warp-cpu x legacy / xe_v2); identity + validation + protocol block; exact depletion with debt; recycling at the impact cell + CEX hand-off weights; ion MCC hand-off vs march; metastable tables + channel rates vs analytic + energy bookkeeping; metastable production / radiative / wall + both identities; discharge atom + energy identities with every channel (cpu, warp-cpu); cpu vs warp in distribution; checkpoint round trip + bitwise resume; CUDA graph vs direct bitwise; plume domain
